# run -omit .*
# reply Content-Type: application/json
# note Content-Length is rr's own framing, so it outlives a pattern that
# note matches every name
>>> f.rr
-- keeps the framing --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

>>> want f.rr
-- keeps the framing --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 13

{
  "id": 7
}
